rationale: After unfolding every local definition, the Lean proposition is the independent backward branch of Lemma 4.2: it preserves the real nonsingular system, computed residual and update models, complete correction-residual hypothesis, Euclidean and Frobenius norms, current/next indexing, and exact coefficients in (4.15). It additionally records the exact identity (4.18), which follows from the same paper assumptions, and rigorously represents lesssim by an eventual inequality modulo an O(scale^2) remainder. The proof-side iterate comparison is explicit in Lean and explicit in the paper's derivation. Under this asymptotic normalization, each statement implies the other, and the target is nonvacuous.
